# `company.costing_methods`

Dated costing-method switches (average or FIFO), append-only; none means average throughout.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this switch. |
| `method` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | average or fifo, in force from effective_from. |
| `effective_from` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | uq_costing_methods_standing_date | — | First date the method costs, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `status` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | standing, or withdrawn before its date came. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why the method was changed, as the person gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this switch was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal (a person) that recorded this switch. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this switch. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this switch. |
| `withdrawn_at` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | UTC time the switch was withdrawn; null while standing. |
| `withdrawn_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Company principal that withdrew the switch; null while standing. |
| `withdrawn_via` | VARCHAR(16) | yes | — | — | — | — | Interface the switch was withdrawn through; null while standing. |
| `withdraw_reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why the switch was withdrawn; null while standing. |
| `withdraw_audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that withdrew the switch; null while standing. |
